# LiveTools.me - Secure Online Utility Tools Portal

LiveTools.me is a high-performance, responsive portal containing over 500+ client-side utility micro-tools designed to execute entirely inside the secure sandbox of modern browsers. No server dependencies, zero trackers, and complete data privacy.

## System Guidelines & Key Architecture

- **100% Client-Side**: All conversions (Image, PDF, XML, JSON), mathematical formulations (EMI, Loan, Compound interest), and string formatting execute directly in the client browser's local memory.
- **Privacy First**: Sensitive data such as uploaded PDF files, JPEG photographs, passwords, JSON codes, or JWT signatures never leave the user's browser canvas. No telemetry logs or backdoors are present.
- **Permissive License**: All output texts, parsed arrays, compiled PDF documents, and converted file variants generated by this ecosystem are licensed under **CC0 / Public Domain** models and can be used on commercial pages without licensing constraints.

---

## Interactive Primary Core Tools Index

### Image tools
- **PNG to JPG Converter** ([/tools/png-to-jpg](https://livetools.me/tools/png-to-jpg)) - High-fidelity convert PNG formats to JPG.
- **JPG to PNG Converter** ([/tools/jpg-to-png](https://livetools.me/tools/jpg-to-png)) - Convert custom files into lossless transparent PNG.
- **PNG to WebP Converter** ([/tools/png-to-webp](https://livetools.me/tools/png-to-webp)) - Optimize server payloads with WebP translations.
- **WebP to PNG Converter** ([/tools/webp-to-png](https://livetools.me/tools/webp-to-png)) - Export modern WebP files back to generic formats.
- **JPG to WebP Converter** ([/tools/jpg-to-webp](https://livetools.me/tools/jpg-to-webp)) - Direct compression ratio optimizer.
- **WebP to JPG Converter** ([/tools/webp-to-jpg](https://livetools.me/tools/webp-to-jpg)) - Unpack next-gen WebP to legacy channels.
- **Image Compressor** ([/tools/image-compressor](https://livetools.me/tools/image-compressor)) - Scale quality parameters to reduce standard byte levels.
- **Image Resizer & Scaler** ([/tools/image-resizer](https://livetools.me/tools/image-resizer)) - Real-time client-only dimension alteration.
- **Image Metadata Viewer** ([/tools/image-metadata-viewer](https://livetools.me/tools/image-metadata-viewer)) - Inspect EXIF parameters, cameras, and dimensions.
- **Image Color Picker** ([/tools/image-color-picker](https://livetools.me/tools/image-color-picker)) - Canvas eye-dropper to retrieve Hex, RGB, and HSL.
- **Image to Base64 Converter** ([/tools/image-to-base64](https://livetools.me/tools/image-to-base64)) - Compile image files to inline HTML data links.
- **Base64 to Image Decoder** ([/tools/base64-to-image](https://livetools.me/tools/base64-to-image)) - Reconstruct images from string streams.
- **Color Palette Extractor** ([/tools/color-extractor](https://livetools.me/tools/color-extractor)) - Intelligently generate matching theme color grids.

### PDF Tools
- **PDF Metadata Viewer** ([/tools/pdf-metadata-viewer](https://livetools.me/tools/pdf-metadata-viewer)) - Extract details, author variables, and security parameters.
- **PDF Page Counter & Analyzer** ([/tools/pdf-page-counter](https://livetools.me/tools/pdf-page-counter)) - Analyze page structures and viewport guidelines.
- **Image to PDF Compiler** ([/tools/image-to-pdf](https://livetools.me/tools/image-to-pdf)) - Convert one or multiple images into a printable PDF download wrapper.
- **PDF Size Reducer** ([/tools/pdf-size-reducer](https://livetools.me/tools/pdf-size-reducer)) - Simulate standard compression sizes easily.
- **PDF Page Remover** ([/tools/pdf-page-remover](https://livetools.me/tools/pdf-page-remover)) - Split and select ranges of PDF files.

### Developer Formatter & Cryptography
- **JSON Formatter & Beautifier** ([/tools/json-formatter](https://livetools.me/tools/json-formatter)) - Validate and pretty-print JSON files.
- **Base64 Encoder & Decoder** ([/tools/base64-encode-decode](https://livetools.me/tools/base64-encode-decode)) - String conversion interface.
- **URL Encoder & Decoder** ([/tools/url-encode-decode](https://livetools.me/tools/url-encode-decode)) - Percent-encoding sanitization of web parameters.
- **SECURE UUID Generator** ([/tools/uuid-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/uuid-generator)) - Cryptographically secure RFC4122 v4 keys.
- **JWT Decoder & Inspector** ([/tools/jwt-decoder](https://livetools.me/tools/jwt-decoder)) - Inspect standard headers, payload claims, and sign times.
- **Cryptography Hash Generator** ([/tools/hash-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/hash-generator)) - Extract MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 integrity checksums.
- **XML Formatter & Prettifier** ([/tools/xml-formatter](https://livetools.me/tools/xml-formatter)) - Rectify indentation and namespaces of XML paths.
- **HTML, CSS & JS Minifier** ([/tools/css-js-minifier](https://livetools.me/tools/css-js-minifier)) - Speed up loading limits by purging developer comments and spacer lines.
- **SQL Query Formatter** ([/tools/sql-formatter](https://livetools.me/tools/sql-formatter)) - Re-align statement words and handle upper-casing.

### Financial & Medical Calculators
- **Precision Age Calculator** ([/tools/age-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/age-calculator)) - Exact dates since birth in multiple factors.

- **Mutual Fund SIP Calculator** ([/tools/sip-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/sip-calculator)) - Future compounding estimations.
- **Percentage Calculator Suite** ([/tools/percentage-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/percentage-calculator)) - Multi-mode percent delta and change calculator.
- **Body Mass Index (BMI) Calculator** ([/tools/bmi-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/bmi-calculator)) - Health ratings according to metric or imperial.
- **Discount & Sales Calculator** ([/tools/discount-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/discount-calculator)) - Shopping markdown ratios.
- **Compound Interest Calculator** ([/tools/compound-interest-calculator](https://livetools.me/tools/compound-interest-calculator)) - Multi-cycle compound interval math solver.

### Text & String Utilities
- **Word & Character Counter** ([/tools/word-counter](https://livetools.me/tools/word-counter)) - Complete length metrics, reading speed multipliers, and densities.
- **Text Case Converter** ([/tools/case-converter](https://livetools.me/tools/case-converter)) - Convert text values to Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, or slug formats.
- **Duplicate Line Remover** ([/tools/remove-duplicate-lines](https://livetools.me/tools/remove-duplicate-lines)) - Clean matching line duplicates completely.
- **Secure Password Generator** ([/tools/random-password-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/random-password-generator)) - Strong combinations of symbols and numbers locally.
- **Lorem Ipsum Placeholder Generator** ([/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator)) - Draft structural paragraph copies.
- **URL Slug Generator** ([/tools/slug-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/slug-generator)) - Convert dynamic article headers to SEO-safe web routes.

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Marketing Tools
- **Meta Tag Generator** ([/tools/meta-tag-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/meta-tag-generator)) - Output header metadata for crawling robots.
- **Robots.txt Generator** ([/tools/robots-txt-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/robots-txt-generator)) - Formulate standard user-agent blocking/allow paths.
- **Open Graph Generator** ([/tools/open-graph-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/open-graph-generator)) - Generate Facebook and Twitter social tags.
- **JSON-LD Schema Generator** ([/tools/json-ld-schema-generator](https://livetools.me/tools/json-ld-schema-generator)) - Rich search product, FAQ, or organization snippets.

---

## Compliance & Sandboxing Details

- All inputs are processed entirely using browser side Javascript memory arrays (`Uint8Array`, `FileReader()`, standard window context).
- No outbound analytics transmit user content variables. Fully safe for proprietary corporate schemas, secure developer keys, and private personnel records.
